# OAGPT (CodersGPT UI)

> Next-generation AI Chat, Coding Assistant, and Image Studio interface.

## Core Features

- [Chat Interface](https://oagpt.com/): Conversational AI assistant supporting Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek R1, Llama 3.3 70B, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
- [AI Image Studio](https://oagpt.com/images): High-resolution AI image generation powered by FLUX 1 Schnell.
- [OAGPT Plus Subscription](https://oagpt.com/upgrade): Premium intelligence upgrade plan.
- [Authentication](https://oagpt.com/auth/signin): Secure login and signup powered by Better Auth.

## Technology Stack

- Framework: Next.js (App Router, Turbopack)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS & Radix UI / Shadcn UI components
- Database: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM
- Authentication: Better Auth
- LLM Integration: LangChain JS, Google Generative AI, OpenAI, and OpenRouter
